report.explanation: All four log reads failed with SNAPSHOT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so no service telemetry substantiates any root cause. Tool failures are missing evidence, not proof of a fault. No candidate can be bounded; handoff requires restored log access and latency/error telemetry.
